component.name: Offcut
component.summary: Trim a video and export it

description.p: Offcut is a single-source video trimmer. Open a file, choose the piece you want to keep, and export it. Your original file is never modified.
It does crop, straighten, speed, volume and tone adjustment on one clip, and exports MP4, MOV, or MKV carrying H.264 or HEVC.
